s: strI, (mahatyA mahAdevyA azwamI । mahatI azwamIti vA .) ASvinaSuklAzwamI । yaTA, -- “ASvine Suklapakzasya Baved yA azwamI tiTiH । mahAzwamIti sA proktA devyAH prItikarA parA ॥” iti kAlikApurARe 59 aDyAyaH ॥ tasyAM pUjAviDiH puttravat upavAsanizezaDaSca yaTA, -- “azwamyAM ruDirErmAMsErmahAmAMsEH suganDiBiH । pUjayedvahujAtIyErbaliBirBojanEH SivAm ॥ sindUrEH pawwavAsESca nAnAviDavilepanEH । puzpEranekajAtIyEH PalErbahuviDErapi ॥ upavAsaM mahAzwamyAM puttravAnna samAcaret । yaTA taTEva pUtAtmA vratI devIM prapUjayet ॥ pUjayitvA mahAzwamyAM navamyAM valiBistaTA । visarjayeddaSamyAntu SravaRe sAvarotsavEH ॥” iti tatrEva 60 aDyAyaH ॥ tatrArdDarAtrapUjA । yaTA, -- “kanyAsaMsTe ravAvISe SuklAzwamyAM prapUjayet । sopavAso niSArdDe tu mahAviBavavistarEH ॥ pUjAM samAraBeddevyA nakzatre vAruRe'pi vA । paSuGAtaSca karttavyo gavalAjavaDastaTA ॥” iti devIpurARavacane vAruRapadena pUrvvAzAQocyate । iti tiTyAditattvam ॥
v: strI karma॰ । “ASvine Suklapakzasya Baved yA tiTi razwamI । mahAzwamIti sA proktA” ityuktAyAmASvinaSuklAzwamyAm ।
